description: A battalion training officer must publish tomorrow's schedule for three mandatory refresher sessions, assigning each section a time and training location and recording the coordination actions needed before instruction begins.

shared_context.S1: Tomorrow's battalion training day includes one signal refresher, one medical-response refresher, and one motor-pool safety refresher.
shared_context.S2: The training complex has a classroom, a radio laboratory, and a vehicle-maintenance bay available for scheduled instruction.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez publishes the final training schedule and must avoid overlapping instructors or facilities.
shared_context.S4: At the routine afternoon training synchronization, Maj. Alvarez asks the signal, medical, and motor-pool representatives for updates before publishing the schedule.

PF1.text: The signal refresher must use the radio laboratory because it includes a 90-minute encryption-key loading practical, and the laboratory is available for that section only from 1000 to 1130 tomorrow; SFC Morgan received the laboratory manager's confirmation this morning, but the training calendar has not yet been updated.

PF2.text: The medical refresher instructor is covering clinic operations until noon and can teach only from 1300 to 1500 tomorrow, in the classroom; Lt. Patel confirmed the coverage roster at today's clinic brief, but the availability change has not reached the training office.

PF3.text: The motor-pool safety refresher requires the vehicle-maintenance bay for a hands-on lockout inspection and must run from 0800 to 1000 tomorrow; SFC Brooks secured the bay reservation during this morning's maintenance meeting, but it is still recorded only on the motor-pool board.

acceptance_conditions: The signal refresher must run from 1000 to 1130 in the radio laboratory.
The medical refresher must run from 1300 to 1500 in the classroom.
The motor-pool safety refresher must run from 0800 to 1000 in the vehicle-maintenance bay.
The published schedule must include a coordination action for each section's confirmed training requirement.
The medical instructor availability must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'training_calendar_update' and c['target'] == 'signal' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'instructor_schedule_update' and c['target'] == 'medical' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'facility_reservation_update' and c['target'] == 'motor-pool' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The radio-laboratory practical changes the signal session to exactly 1000-1130 in the radio laboratory and requires a signal training-calendar update.
The instructor's clinic coverage changes the medical session to exactly 1300-1500 in the classroom, requires a medical instructor-schedule update, and must be cited as justification.
The hands-on lockout inspection and reserved bay change the motor-pool session to exactly 0800-1000 in the vehicle-maintenance bay and require a motor-pool facility-reservation update.
